item.title: How many ships are crossing the Strait of Hormuz?
item.summary: Four vessels have crossed the Strait of Hormuz ahead of a US military blockade of Iranian ports set to begin on Monday.

item.title: UK will not join blockade of Iran's ports in the Strait of Hormuz
item.summary: UK minesweepers and anti-drone capabilities will continue operating in the region, as pressure ramps up to reopen the key shipping route.

item.title: How the Iran war affects your money and bills
item.summary: The conflict in the Middle East has increased pressure on the cost of petrol, household energy bills and even food.

item.title: Palestinian shot dead during Israeli settler attack on occupied West Bank village
item.summary: The killing came as ex-security chiefs warned "government sponsored Jewish terrorism" was out of control.

item.title: Ceasefire or no ceasefire, the Middle East's reshuffling is not yet done
item.summary: Both sides have reason to end the war but share no common ground.

item.title: 'Endless fears': Even if fighting stops, the damage to Iran's children will endure
item.summary: The BBC has been able to obtain testimony from parents and those trying to help children deal with the distress that comes with war.

item.title: Lebanon thought there was a ceasefire - then Israel unleashed deadly blitz
item.summary: Israel says Lebanon is not included in the ceasefire the US agreed to halt the war with Iran.

item.title: BBC at the site of Israeli air strikes in Beirut
item.summary: At least 182 people were killed and 890 others wounded, according to the Lebanese health ministry.

item.title: Has US achieved its war objectives in Iran?
item.summary: Key US objectives at the start of the war were to stop Iran getting a nuclear weapon and degrading its arsenal.

item.title: Israeli strikes in Lebanon 'grave violation' of ceasefire, Iran minister tells BBC
item.summary: Iran's deputy foreign minister says the US must choose between 'war and ceasefire'.
